productionManifests.semanticIntent: Faction-neutral physical authoring exemplar proving exact fit components, hull, shipyard and installed support facilities can be validated before faction package bulk authoring.

supportEnduranceRequirements.semanticReason: Thirty-day stores floor is below the accepted bulk-freighter calibration and is a planning gate, not a hidden performance bonus.
Forty-five-day stores floor remains below the accepted tanker calibration so replenishment endurance is explicit before faction-specific tuning.
The accepted industrial mining-hull endurance is used only as a conservative thirty-day industrial-support analogue; dedicated repair/salvage physical fits remain downstream authoring.
